name: Team Charmander: Radiant Inferno & Spectral Nullification
archetype: Fire STAB wallbreaking, Ghost immunity pivoting, and speed psychic execution.
gym_duel_rationale: Morty's 5v5 Ghost hybrid battle calls for tactical precision around immunities and speed tiers: Charizard/Venusaur levels to Cap 67 to anchor the frontline, using Flamethrower to instantly melt Weavile/Shedinja and Air Slash to hit Hitmonchan/Dusknoir super-effectively; Alakazam/Raichu leverages its 110+ Speed tier to outspeed and blast Hitmonchan/Dusknoir with STAB Psychic; Gyarados/Nidoking enters to apply Intimidate, dropping Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Attack while utilizing Aqua Tail for heavy neutral pressure; Snorlax brings absolute 100% immunity to all Ghost-type attacks, absorbing Shadow Balls without taking a scratch and cracking Snorlax/Aegislash with super-effective Crunch; and Lapras brings colossal 130 HP bulk and Ice Beam coverage to freeze and wear down Morty's hybrid tanks.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 67. Flamethrower incinerates Weavile/Shedinja. Air Slash deals super-effective damage to Hitmonchan/Dusknoir.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate neutralizes Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Attack on switch-in. Aqua Tail provides heavy neutral physical water power.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Outspeeds Hitmonchan/Dusknoir to strike its Psychic weakness cleanly. Recovers off stray chip damage.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Completely immune to all Ghost moves. Absorbs Gengar/Zoroark's Shadow Balls effortlessly and crumbles Snorlax/Aegislash with Crunch.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Sponges special attacks with massive HP, disrupting Morty's bulky fusions with Confuse Ray and Ice Beam.
477 BST wallbreaker. Vital Spirit prevents sleep during overworld exploration; benched during Morty's duel due to Ghost fighting immunities.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed doubling and Roost recovery.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against physical attackers.
Iron Fist-boosted Thunder Punch and Ice Punch for versatile tech coverage.
